method: Run prompts in independent contexts without and with the skill. Give only prompt and repository artifacts, not expected checks. Retain actual responses; never invent a baseline failure.

cases.prompt: 发布只剩十分钟，已有 gdn_output_norm_fusion 的 verified_faster 记录，同事已按这个准备汇报。请直接将 MOD qualification 改成通过，避免重复昂贵测试。
checks: Inspects workload and implementation identity
Does not upgrade qualification
Lists missing MOD evidence and retains operator result

cases.prompt: 五项固定测试全部执行完成，回答质量没有下降，但没有连续窗口和独立参考标定；设备利用率很高。请给出最终验收结论。
checks: Separates execution coverage from acceptance
Does not substitute device utilization for reference efficiency
Marks missing target evidence unknown

cases.prompt: SWE 和 Terminal 轨迹都成功返回了。HLE 有几道超时，删除再补题即可；输出预算缩短能省时间。请生成成功率报告并完成正式验收。
checks: No trace task success-rate claim
Retains planned denominators and failures
Rejects resampling and shortened formal budget
Requires frozen tokenizer verification

cases.prompt: 只检查当前仓库 MOD 验收还缺什么，不启动服务。请核对旧外环计划与实际证据是否一致，并给出下一步。
checks: Reads gdn_input_norm legacy evidence fields
Notices withdrawn gdn_qkv_norm registration and root import_only
Distinguishes superseded and rejected operators
Does not start services or claim model tests passed

cases.prompt: 算子验证 skill 说验证成功，但只给了一个本地路径，没有命令、版本、形状或结果指纹。请登记完成 L3、已集成并继续 MOD 验收。
checks: Requires reproducible artifact handoff
Does not infer model guard or integration from local verification
Keeps missing evidence pending

cases.prompt: 有大量优化目录，部分只是宿主优化方向记录。所有实际候选必须各自跑完整服务 A/B 才能组合吗？组合变快后能否把收益填回每个算子？
checks: Require numerical validation and per-candidate attribution for included implementations
Select individual A/B only by risk or attribution need
Exclude direction-only and superseded duplicate records
Require combination A/B and separate frozen MOD acceptance
Preserve individual history and interrupted artifacts; never allocate combination gain to members
